intro.text: A planet in the cosmere. Its kingdom of Mountaincrest sits on a vast mountain whose slope is so gentle it is hard to notice from the ground, with the capital, Kingseat, at the top.

A remote planet in the cosmere, away from the usual travel routes, where Valor built temples and founded a religion. Its kingdom of Mountaincrest covers a vast, gently sloping mountain with the capital, Kingseat, at its peak.

description.text: Higher up the mountain the air is cooler and scrubland gives way to pine forest. Three rivers that start at the Megalith run through Mountaincrest; they carry the Megalith's blood, not water, and have long been major routes for travel across the kingdom.

Its subastral lies close to many entities of negative Investiture, and its natural perpendicularity is unusually irregular and not attuned to any Shard, so the planet is hard to reach. Valor built temples on Miral and founded an organized religion there.
South of Mountaincrest stretch wide plains, home to several nomadic peoples who live among huge demons. Their religion and way of life center on dealing with, binding and serving those demons.
